blocks.text: Okada Manila has been named Asia’s Leading Entertainment Resort 2026 at the World Travel Awards, marking another major recognition for the 30-hectare luxury integrated resort. The award adds to Okada Manila’s growing recognition as a destination where guests can stay, dine, unwind, shop, celebrate, and enjoy entertainment within one property. The World Travel Awards recognizes excellence across the global travel and tourism industry.
